cn-20260918-news-1.title: 95th Anniversary of the September 18 Incident: Air Raid Sirens Sound in Shenyang, Commemorative Ceremonies Held Across the Country

segments.src: 2026年9月18日9时18分，沈阳市上空准时响起长达3分钟的防空警报。与此同时,道路上的机动车集中鸣笛,行人驻足肃立,城市的喧嚣在这一刻短暂停歇。这一天,是"九一八事变"爆发95周年纪念日。
segments.tr: At 9:18 on September 18, 2026, air raid sirens sounded punctually over Shenyang for three minutes. At the same time, motor vehicles on the roads honked their horns in unison, pedestrians stopped and stood in silence, and the city's hustle and bustle paused for a brief moment. This day marks the 95th anniversary of the outbreak of the "September 18 Incident."

segments.src: 据公开报道,沈阳"九一八"历史博物馆当天举行主题纪念活动,现场敲响警世钟,并举行默哀仪式,悼念在那场事变及此后战乱中罹难的同胞。除沈阳外,黑龙江、吉林、安徽等地的多个城市也在同一时间统一拉响警报,以肃穆的方式共同缅怀这段历史。
segments.tr: According to public reports, the "9.18" Historical Museum in Shenyang held a themed commemorative event that day, where the warning bell was struck and a moment of silence was observed to mourn the compatriots who perished in that incident and the subsequent wars. In addition to Shenyang, multiple cities in Heilongjiang, Jilin, Anhui, and other provinces also sounded sirens at the same time, collectively commemorating this history in a solemn manner.
## Looking back at the historical moment 95 years ago

segments.src: 1931年9月18日夜,盘踞在中国东北的日本关东军制造了柳条湖铁路爆破事件,并以此为借口突袭沈阳北大营,炮轰沈阳城。由于当时中国东北地区未能进行有效抵抗,日军在数月内相继占领了辽宁、吉林、黑龙江等地,东北随后陷入长达十四年的沦陷时期。
segments.tr: On the night of September 18, 1931, the Japanese Kwantung Army, entrenched in Northeast China, fabricated the Liutiaohu Railway bombing incident and used it as a pretext to launch a surprise attack on the Beidaying barracks in Shenyang and shell the city. Due to the lack of effective resistance in Northeast China at the time, the Japanese army occupied Liaoning, Jilin, Heilongjiang, and other areas within a few months, and the Northeast subsequently fell into a 14-year period of occupation.

segments.src: 这一事件被称为"九一八事变",也称"奉天事变"或"柳条湖事件",是中国近代史上的重大转折点之一,深刻影响了此后中国乃至东亚地区的历史走向。此后,中国人民展开了艰苦卓绝的抗日斗争,最终迎来了1945年抗日战争的全面胜利。
segments.tr: This event is known as the "September 18 Incident," also called the "Mukden Incident" or the "Liutiaohu Incident." It was one of the major turning points in modern Chinese history and profoundly influenced the historical trajectory of China and even East Asia thereafter. Since then, the Chinese people launched an arduous struggle against Japanese aggression, eventually leading to the comprehensive victory of the War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression in 1945.

segments.src: ## 鸣笛与警报:一种延续多年的纪念方式
segments.tr: ## Sirens and honking: A commemorative practice spanning many years

segments.src: 自20世纪90年代起,沈阳等城市每年9月18日都会在事变发生的时刻拉响防空警报,提醒市民铭记这段历史。这一做法此后逐渐扩展到东北及全国其他多个城市,成为一种被广泛认可的公共纪念仪式。
segments.tr: Since the 1990s, cities like Shenyang have sounded air raid sirens every year on September 18 at the time the incident occurred to remind citizens to remember this history. This practice subsequently expanded to the Northeast and many other cities across the country, becoming a widely recognized public commemorative ritual.

segments.src: 在纪念当天,不少学校、社区和企事业单位也会组织默哀、参观纪念馆、主题讲座等活动,通过多种形式向青少年讲述这段历史。教育工作者普遍认为,这类活动有助于帮助年轻一代了解民族历史,增强历史认知,而非停留于单纯的情绪表达。
segments.tr: On the day of commemoration, many schools, communities, and enterprises also organize activities such as moments of silence, visits to memorial halls, and themed lectures to teach young people about this history through various forms. Educators generally believe that such activities help the younger generation understand national history and enhance their historical awareness, rather than stopping at simple emotional expression.

segments.src: 95年过去,当年的战火早已远去,中国也已发生翻天覆地的变化。每年响起的警报声,更多被官方与学界诠释为一种历史教育与和平提醒——提醒人们珍惜来之不易的和平发展环境,同时以史为鉴,推动面向未来的睦邻友好与地区稳定。
segments.tr: 95 years have passed, the flames of war from that time have long since faded, and China has undergone earth-shaking changes. The sirens that sound every year are increasingly interpreted by officials and scholars as a form of historical education and a reminder of peace—reminding people to cherish the hard-won environment for peaceful development, while also using history as a mirror to promote good-neighborly friendship and regional stability for the future.

segments.src: 正如多位历史学者在接受媒体采访时所言,纪念"九一八"的意义不在于延续对立情绪,而在于让更多人,尤其是年轻一代,真正理解和平的可贵,并以理性、建设性的态度看待历史与现实,共同致力于地区的长久和平与发展。
segments.tr: As many historians have stated in media interviews, the significance of commemorating the "September 18 Incident" lies not in perpetuating confrontational sentiments, but in allowing more people, especially the younger generation, to truly understand the value of peace and to view history and reality with a rational and constructive attitude, working together for long-term regional peace and development.

cn-20260918-intro-marketing-15.title: [Marketing #15] A Practical Marketing Plan Actually Answers Only Six Questions (With Full-Semester Review)

segments.src: > 营销战略不是灵感，而是把"现状如何—选谁—给什么—花多少—怎么算账"写成一条能执行、能被检验的链条。
segments.tr: > Marketing strategy is not about inspiration, but about writing down "where we are—who to choose—what to give—how much to spend—how to balance the books" into an executable and verifiable chain.

segments.src: 前面十四讲讲的是零件，今天讲的是把零件装进同一台机器：**营销计划书（Marketing Plan）**。它通常回答六个问题。
segments.tr: The previous fourteen lectures were about the parts. Today we will talk about assembling those parts into the same machine: the **Marketing Plan**. It usually answers six questions.

segments.src: 我们现在在哪里？（情境分析）**
最常用的框架是 3C：顾客（Customer）在意什么、竞争者（Competitor）已经提供了什么、公司（Company）手里有什么资源和能力。再用 SWOT 把内部的优势/劣势与外部的机会/威胁摆在一页纸上。这一步的纪律是：只写有证据的判断，"我觉得年轻人喜欢"不算证据，问卷、销售数据、门店观察才算。
segments.tr: The most commonly used framework is the 3Cs: what the Customer cares about, what the Competitor has already provided, and what resources and capabilities the Company has. Then, use SWOT to put internal strengths/weaknesses and external opportunities/threats on a single page. The discipline of this step is: only write down judgments backed by evidence. "I feel young people like it" does not count as evidence; questionnaires, sales data, and store observations do.

segments.src: 目标要区分两层：**经营目标**（销售额、利润）和**营销目标**（市场份额、复购率、认知度）。写法遵循 SMART——具体、可衡量、可达成、相关、有时限。"提升知名度"不是目标，"6 个月内周边写字楼白领的品牌提及率从 10% 提到 25%"才是。
segments.tr: Objectives should be divided into two levels: **business objectives** (sales revenue, profit) and **marketing objectives** (market share, repeat purchase rate, awareness). The writing should follow SMART—Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. "Improving brand awareness" is not an objective, but "increasing the brand mention rate among white-collar workers in surrounding office buildings from 10% to 25% within 6 months" is.

segments.src: 我们服务谁、凭什么被选中？（STP）**
segments.tr: Who do we serve, and why are we chosen? (STP)**

segments.src: 细分（Segmentation）→ 选择目标市场（Targeting）→ 定位（Positioning）。最后要能写出一句**定位陈述**：为【谁】，我们是【什么品类】中【唯一/最……的那个】，因为【支撑理由】。
segments.tr: Segmentation → Targeting → Positioning. Finally, you should be able to write a **Positioning Statement**: For [whom], we are [the only/most... one] in [what category], because [supporting reasons].

segments.src: 我们具体给什么？（营销组合 4P）**
segments.tr: What specifically do we offer? (Marketing Mix 4Ps)**

segments.src: 产品、价格、渠道、促销。判断 4P 写得好不好，只有一条标准：**四者是否互相印证**。高端定价配廉价渠道、强调品质却只做打折促销，计划书写得再漂亮也会在执行中散架。
segments.tr: Product, Price, Place, Promotion. There is only one standard to judge whether the 4Ps are written well: **whether the four reinforce each other**. High-end pricing paired with cheap channels, or emphasizing quality but only doing discount promotions, will cause even the most beautiful plan to fall apart during execution.

segments.src: 花多少、谁来做、什么时候做？（预算与日程）**
segments.tr: How much will it cost, who will do it, and when? (Budget & Schedule)**

segments.src: 把每项动作对应到人、时间和金额。没有预算和负责人的计划书，本质上是愿望清单。
segments.tr: Map every action to a person, time, and amount. A plan without a budget and a responsible person is essentially a wish list.

segments.src: 怎么知道做对了？（控制与评估）**
segments.tr: How do we know we did it right? (Control & Evaluation)**

segments.src: 事先定好 3～5 个 KPI 和复盘节奏，并写清楚"偏差多少就要调整、先调哪一项"。战略的另一半是取舍——**明确写下"我们不做什么"**，和写下要做什么同样重要。
segments.tr: Set 3 to 5 KPIs and a review rhythm in advance, and clearly write down "how much deviation requires adjustment, and which item to adjust first." The other half of strategy is trade-offs—**explicitly writing down "what we do not do"** is just as important as writing down what we will do.

segments.src: **把前十四讲装进这六个格子：**
segments.tr: **Fitting the first fourteen lectures into these six boxes:**

segments.src: 市场调研与消费者行为 → 第 1 步；市场细分、目标市场、定位 → 第 3 步；产品与品牌、定价、渠道、促销与整合营销传播（IMC）、数字营销 → 第 4 步；客户关系管理与营销绩效指标 → 第 6 步。整门课其实就是这一张表的展开。
segments.tr: Market Research & Consumer Behavior → Step 1; Market Segmentation, Targeting, & Positioning → Step 3; Product & Brand, Pricing, Place, Promotion & Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC), Digital Marketing → Step 4; Customer Relationship Management & Marketing Performance Metrics → Step 6. The entire course is actually the unfolding of this single table.

segments.src: 小林要在杭州滨江地铁口开一家 40 平米的手冲咖啡店，月租 1.8 万元。她的计划书是这样写的：
segments.tr: Xiao Lin wants to open a 40-square-meter pour-over coffee shop at the Hangzhou Binjiang subway exit, with a monthly rent of 18,000 RMB. Her plan is written like this:

segments.src: **情境分析**：周边写字楼工位约 8000 个；竞争者是 3 家连锁品牌，客单价 20 元左右、主打出杯快；自身优势是她本人是咖啡师，能稳定做单一产地手冲；劣势是没有品牌认知、启动资金有限。
segments.tr: **Situation Analysis**: There are about 8,000 workstations in the surrounding office buildings; competitors are 3 chain brands with an average transaction price of around 20 RMB, focusing on fast serving; her own strength is that she is a barista herself and can stably make single-origin pour-over coffee; her weakness is the lack of brand awareness and limited starting capital.

segments.src: **目标**：开业 6 个月内，工作日日均出杯 120 杯，30 天内复购率达到 35%。
segments.tr: **Objectives**: Within 6 months of opening, average 120 cups per day on weekdays, and achieve a 35% repeat purchase rate within 30 days.

segments.src: **STP**：按到店动机把人群分成"提神快取""社交久坐""口味尝鲜"三类；选择第一类中对风味有要求的白领；定位陈述是"为滨江写字楼的通勤白领，提供 3 分钟能拿走、但风味可挑选的手冲咖啡"。
segments.tr: **STP**: Segment the crowd into three categories based on store-visiting motivation: "quick energy boost," "socializing & lingering," and "trying new flavors"; target white-collar workers in the first category who have requirements for flavor; the positioning statement is "For commuting white-collar workers in Binjiang office buildings, we provide pour-over coffee that can be taken away in 3 minutes, yet with selectable flavors."

segments.src: **4P**：产品是固定 2 支基础奶咖 + 每周轮换 2 支单一产地豆；价格是基础款 22 元、手冲 32 元，另有 199 元 15 杯的月卡用来锁定复购；渠道是小程序提前点单、到店自取，外卖只覆盖 1.5 公里；促销是企业微信社群 + 早 8:00–9:00「早鸟减 4 元」+ 与楼下健身房互发优惠券。
segments.tr: **4Ps**: Product is a fixed 2 basic milk coffees + 2 rotating single-origin beans weekly; Price is 22 RMB for basic models and 32 RMB for pour-over, with a monthly card of 199 RMB for 15 cups to lock in repeat purchases; Place is pre-ordering via mini-program and in-store pickup, with delivery covering only 1.5 km; Promotion is Enterprise WeChat community + "Early Bird 4 RMB off" from 8:00 to 9:00 AM + mutual coupon distribution with the gym downstairs.

segments.src: **预算**：首月推广 1.2 万元——社群运营与免费试饮 6000 元，联名券 3000 元，小程序与物料 3000 元。
segments.tr: **Budget**: 12,000 RMB for the first month's promotion—6,000 RMB for community operations and free tasting, 3,000 RMB for co-branded coupons, and 3,000 RMB for the mini-program and materials.

segments.src: **控制**：每周只盯三个数——日均杯数、月卡续费率、早鸟时段订单占比。
segments.tr: **Control**: Monitor only three numbers weekly—average daily cups, monthly card renewal rate, and the proportion of orders during the early bird period.

segments.src: 这份计划书里最容易出事的地方，正是 4P 的一致性：32 元的手冲要兑现"3 分钟拿走"，就必须提前分装咖啡粉、固定水温和萃取流程。做不到，定位陈述就是一句空话，再多折扣也救不回来。所以当月卡续费率不达标时，第一反应不该是加大折扣，而是回头检查产品和定位有没有对上。
segments.tr: The most accident-prone part of this plan is precisely the consistency of the 4Ps: to deliver on the promise of "take away in 3 minutes" for a 32 RMB pour-over, coffee powder must be pre-portioned, and water temperature and extraction processes must be standardized. If this cannot be done, the positioning statement is just empty words, and no amount of discounts can save it. Therefore, when the monthly card renewal rate falls short of expectations, the first reaction should not be to increase discounts, but to go back and check whether the product and positioning align.

segments.src: 1. 营销计划书 = 情境分析 → 目标 → STP → 4P → 预算与日程 → 控制评估，六步缺一不可。
segments.tr: 1. Marketing Plan = Situation Analysis → Objectives → STP → 4Ps → Budget & Schedule → Control & Evaluation; none of the six steps can be omitted.

segments.src: 2. 判断计划书好坏的核心标准是**一致性**：4P 之间、4P 与定位之间必须互相印证。
segments.tr: 2. The core standard for judging the quality of a plan is **consistency**: the 4Ps must reinforce each other, and the 4Ps must align with the positioning.

segments.src: 3. 战略等于取舍，写清楚"不做什么"和设好复盘指标，计划才可能真正落地。
segments.tr: 3. Strategy equals trade-offs. Only by clearly writing down "what not to do" and setting up review metrics can the plan truly be put into practice.

segments.src: **1.（单选）** 下列哪一项属于 3C 分析中"公司（Company）"这一维度？
segments.tr: **1. (Single Choice)** Which of the following belongs to the "Company" dimension in the 3C analysis?

segments.src: 竞争对手的平均出杯速度
segments.tr: The average serving speed of competitors

segments.src: 店主本人稳定的手冲技术
segments.tr: The owner's own stable pour-over skills

segments.src: 周边白领每天的咖啡预算
segments.tr: The daily coffee budget of surrounding white-collar workers

segments.src: **2.（O/X）** 把营销目标写成"提升品牌知名度"，已经符合 SMART 原则。
segments.tr: **2. (True/False)** Writing a marketing objective as "improving brand awareness" already conforms to the SMART principle.

segments.src: **3.（单选）** 按本讲的顺序，月卡续费率明显低于预期时，第一步最应该做的是？
segments.tr: **3. (Single Choice)** According to the order of this lecture, when the monthly card renewal rate is significantly lower than expected, what is the first step that should be taken?

segments.src: 回到定位与 4P，检查两者是否一致
segments.tr: Return to positioning and the 4Ps to check if they are consistent

segments.src: 暂停所有推广，观察一个月
segments.tr: Suspend all promotions and observe for a month

segments.src: - **营销计划书（Marketing Plan）**：把营销战略写成可执行、可检验文件的整体方案。
segments.tr: - **Marketing Plan**: An overall proposal that writes marketing strategy into an executable and verifiable document.

segments.src: - **3C 分析**：从顾客、竞争者、公司三个角度做情境分析的框架。
segments.tr: - **3C Analysis**: A framework for situation analysis from three perspectives: Customer, Competitor, and Company.

segments.src: - **SWOT 分析**：把内部优势/劣势与外部机会/威胁并列，用于连接现状与策略。
segments.tr: - **SWOT Analysis**: Juxtaposing internal strengths/weaknesses with external opportunities/threats to connect the current situation with strategies.

segments.src: - **定位陈述（Positioning Statement）**：用一句话说明"为谁、在什么品类、凭什么被选中"。
segments.tr: - **Positioning Statement**: A single sentence explaining "for whom, in what category, and why we are chosen."

segments.src: - **SMART 目标**：具体、可衡量、可达成、相关、有时限的目标写法。
segments.tr: - **SMART Objectives**: A way of writing objectives that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound.

segments.src: *答案：1 — B。顾客预算属于 Customer，竞争对手出杯速度属于 Competitor，只有自身技术与资源属于 Company。2 — X。"提升知名度"没有可衡量的数字和时限，需改写成"6 个月内提及率从 10% 提到 25%"这类表述。3 — B。控制环节的作用是先定位偏差原因；折扣和投放是手段，若定位与 4P 本身不一致，加大投入只会加快亏损。*
segments.tr: *Answer: 1 — B. Customer budget belongs to Customer, competitor serving speed belongs to Competitor, and only one's own skills and resources belong to Company. 2 — X. "Improving awareness" has no measurable numbers or time limits; it needs to be rewritten into expressions like "increasing the mention rate from 10% to 25% within 6 months." 3 — B. The role of the control phase is to first locate the cause of the deviation; discounts and advertising are means, and if the positioning and the 4Ps themselves are inconsistent, increasing investment will only accelerate losses.*

cn-20260918-news-2.title: Pinglu Canal Officially Opens to Navigation: Shipping Distance for Southwest China to the Sea Shortened by Up to 560 Kilometers

segments.src: ## 新中国首条国家层面统筹建设的通江达海运河通航
segments.tr: ## The First Canal Connecting Rivers and Seas Planned and Constructed at the National Level in New China Opens to Navigation

segments.src: 9月16日,备受关注的平陆运河正式通航。这条运河北接西江水系,南连广西钦州湾,是新中国成立以来第一条由国家层面统筹规划建设的运河工程,也是连接内陆水运网络与北部湾出海口的重要基础设施。
segments.tr: On September 16, the highly anticipated Pinglu Canal officially opened to navigation. This canal, connecting the Xijiang River system in the north to Qinzhou Bay in Guangxi in the south, is the first canal project planned and constructed at the national level since the founding of New China. It is also a crucial piece of infrastructure linking the inland waterway network with the Beibu Gulf seaport.

segments.src: 运河通航后,来自云南、贵州、四川、重庆及广西内陆地区的货物,不再需要绕道珠江水系经广州出海,而是可以经西江、邕江直接由平陆运河进入钦州湾,再转海运通达全球。据测算,这一新航道最多可将西南地区的出海航程缩短约560公里。
segments.tr: With the canal now open, cargo from Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, Chongqing, and inland Guangxi no longer needs to detour through the Pearl River system via Guangzhou to reach the sea. Instead, it can travel via the Xijiang and Yongjiang rivers directly into Qinzhou Bay through the Pinglu Canal, and then be shipped globally. Estimates suggest that this new route can shorten the shipping distance to the sea for the Southwest region by up to approximately 560 kilometers.

segments.src: ## 物流成本有望明显下降
segments.tr: ## Logistics Costs Expected to Drop Significantly

segments.src: 对于长期依赖江海联运、公铁联运等多式联运方式出海的西南地区企业而言,平陆运河的意义不仅在于航程缩短,更在于物流成本的实质性下降。相关测算显示,借助平陆运河出海,相关地区的物流成本预计可降低18%至30%。
segments.tr: For enterprises in the Southwest region that have long relied on multi-modal transport methods such as river-sea combined transport and road-rail combined transport to reach the sea, the significance of the Pinglu Canal lies not only in the shortened distance but also in the substantial reduction of logistics costs. Relevant estimates show that by using the Pinglu Canal to reach the sea, logistics costs in related regions are expected to decrease by 18% to 30%.

segments.src: 物流成本的下降,意味着西南地区出口企业在大宗商品运输、原材料采购以及制成品出口等环节都将获得更强的价格竞争力。对于煤炭、矿石、粮食等大宗货物运输企业,以及电子、机械、轻工等制造业出口企业来说,新航道有望成为压缩运输时间与仓储周转成本的重要选项。
segments.tr: The reduction in logistics costs means that export enterprises in the Southwest region will gain stronger price competitiveness in areas such as bulk commodity transportation, raw material procurement, and the export of finished goods. For companies involved in the transport of bulk goods like coal, ore, and grain, as well as manufacturing exporters in sectors like electronics, machinery, and light industry, the new route is expected to become an important option for compressing transport time and warehousing turnover costs.

segments.src: ## 从"内陆"到"沿海":区域经济格局或迎来调整
segments.tr: ## From "Inland" to "Coastal": Regional Economic Landscape May See Adjustments

segments.src: 长期以来,云南、贵州等西南省份因深处内陆、远离沿海港口,在参与国际贸易时普遍面临运输链条长、中转环节多的问题。平陆运河建成通航后,这些地区通过内河航道即可直达北部湾出海口,区域经济地理格局有望随之发生变化。
segments.tr: For a long time, Southwest provinces like Yunnan and Guizhou have faced problems such as long transport chains and numerous transshipment links when participating in international trade due to their deep inland location, far from coastal ports. With the completion and opening of the Pinglu Canal, these regions can now reach the Beibu Gulf seaport directly via inland waterways, and the regional economic and geographical landscape is expected to change accordingly.

segments.src: 分析认为,平陆运河的通航将进一步强化广西北部湾港作为西南地区出海门户的地位,推动钦州、防城港等沿海城市在仓储、加工、贸易等环节承接更多产业转移和物流业务。同时,运河沿线的内河港口、物流园区等配套设施建设,也可能为区域经济带来新的增长点。
segments.tr: Analysts believe that the opening of the Pinglu Canal will further strengthen the status of the Beibu Gulf Port in Guangxi as a gateway to the sea for the Southwest region, promoting coastal cities like Qinzhou and Fangchenggang to undertake more industrial relocation and logistics business in areas such as warehousing, processing, and trade. At the same time, the construction of supporting facilities such as inland ports and logistics parks along the canal may also bring new growth points to the regional economy.

segments.src: ## 助力中国—东盟贸易往来
从更广的区域经贸格局看,平陆运河所在的北部湾地区,与东盟国家隔海相望,是中国面向东盟开放合作的重要窗口。运河通航后,西南地区与东盟之间的货物往来有望获得更便捷的水运通道支持,为区域内产业链、供应链的进一步整合创造条件。
segments.tr: Looking at the broader regional economic and trade landscape, the Beibu Gulf region where the Pinglu Canal is located faces ASEAN countries across the sea and is an important window for China's opening up and cooperation with ASEAN. With the canal open, cargo exchanges between the Southwest region and ASEAN are expected to gain support from more convenient water transport channels, creating conditions for further integration of industrial and supply chains within the region.

segments.src: 不过也有业内人士提醒,运河的实际效益释放需要一个过程,包括通航初期的运力磨合、配套物流体系的完善,以及沿线港口、园区招商引资的落地节奏等,都将影响这条新航道效益的充分发挥。
segments.tr: However, industry insiders also remind that the release of the canal's actual benefits will take time. Factors such as the initial capacity adjustment, the improvement of supporting logistics systems, and the pace of investment attraction for ports and parks along the route will all affect the full realization of the benefits of this new shipping lane.

segments.src: 总体来看,平陆运河的建成通航,为中国西南地区打通了一条新的出海通道,也为观察区域经济格局演变、中国—东盟经贸合作走向提供了一个新的观察窗口。
segments.tr: Overall, the completion and opening of the Pinglu Canal have opened up a new sea route for Southwest China and provided a new window for observing the evolution of the regional economic landscape and the direction of China-ASEAN economic and trade cooperation.

cn-20260918-news-3.title: China's top 10 consumer counties released: Yiwu tops the list with total retail sales exceeding 215 billion yuan, county-level economy becomes a new engine for domestic demand

segments.src: ## 县域消费版图迎来新格局
segments.tr: ## A new pattern emerges in the county-level consumption landscape

segments.src: 近日，多家研究机构发布的最新县域经济与消费数据显示，全国社会消费品零售总额（社零总额）排名前列的县市中，浙江义乌以超过2150亿元的成绩继续位居榜首，展现出强劲的市场活力和消费吸纳能力。与此同时，江苏昆山、福建晋江、江苏常熟等传统经济强县同样表现亮眼，社零总额均突破千亿元大关，共同构成了当前中国县域消费的“第一梯队”。
segments.tr: Recently, the latest county-level economy and consumption data released by multiple research institutions show that among the counties and cities with the highest total retail sales of consumer goods nationwide, Yiwu, Zhejiang continues to rank first with a performance exceeding 215 billion yuan, demonstrating strong market vitality and consumer absorption capacity. At the same time, traditional economic powerhouses such as Kunshan in Jiangsu, Jinjiang in Fujian, and Changshu in Jiangsu have also performed brilliantly, with their total retail sales all breaking the 100-billion-yuan mark, jointly forming the current "first echelon" of China's county-level consumption.

segments.src: 这份榜单再次印证了一个趋势：在城镇化持续推进和产业结构不断优化的背景下，县域经济正从过去的“制造重镇”角色，逐步转型为兼具生产与消费双重属性的经济单元，成为拉动内需、稳定经济增长的重要新增长极。
segments.tr: This list once again confirms a trend: against the backdrop of continuous advancement in urbanization and continuous optimization of industrial structure, the county-level economy is gradually transforming from its past role as a "manufacturing heavy" to an economic unit with dual attributes of both production and consumption, becoming an important new growth pole for boosting domestic demand and stabilizing economic growth.

segments.src: ## 义乌：小商品之都的消费奇迹
segments.tr: ## Yiwu: The consumption miracle of the small commodity capital

segments.src: 作为全球知名的“世界超市”，义乌长期以来凭借发达的小商品批发市场体系，吸引了大量国内外采购商和创业者聚集。近年来，义乌不仅巩固了其在国际贸易领域的地位，还通过完善商贸配套设施、发展电商直播产业、优化营商环境等举措，持续释放本地消费潜力。
segments.tr: As a globally renowned "world supermarket," Yiwu has long relied on a developed small commodity wholesale market system to attract a large number of domestic and foreign buyers and entrepreneurs to gather. In recent years, Yiwu has not only consolidated its position in the field of international trade, but also continuously released local consumption potential through measures such as improving trade and commerce supporting facilities, developing the e-commerce live-streaming industry, and optimizing the business environment.

segments.src: 业内分析人士指出，义乌社零总额能够突破2150亿元，与其独特的“市场+产业+人口”联动模式密不可分。大量外来经商人口和常住人口共同构成了旺盛的消费基础，而完善的物流网络与商贸配套体系则进一步降低了交易成本，形成了消费与贸易相互促进的良性循环。
segments.tr: Industry analysts pointed out that Yiwu's total retail sales breaking through 215 billion yuan is inextricably linked to its unique "market + industry + population" linkage model. A large number of migrant business people and resident populations jointly constitute a booming consumption foundation, while a sound logistics network and trade supporting system further reduce transaction costs, forming a virtuous cycle of mutual promotion between consumption and trade.

segments.src: ## 昆山、晋江、常熟：各具特色的千亿俱乐部
segments.tr: ## Kunshan, Jinjiang, Changshu: The 100-billion-yuan clubs with their own characteristics

segments.src: 除义乌之外，昆山、晋江、常熟三地同样以突出的社零表现跻身千亿元阵营。
segments.tr: In addition to Yiwu, Kunshan, Jinjiang, and Changshu have also entered the 100-billion-yuan camp with outstanding retail sales performances.

segments.src: - **昆山**依托毗邻上海的区位优势，长期是外向型经济和先进制造业的代表县市之一。近年来，昆山积极推动产业转型升级,同时同步提升城市商业配套水平，带动本地及周边区域消费能力稳步提升。
segments.tr: - **Kunshan**, relying on its geographical advantage of being adjacent to Shanghai, has long been one of the representative counties and cities for export-oriented economies and advanced manufacturing. In recent years, Kunshan has actively promoted industrial transformation and upgrading while simultaneously enhancing the level of urban commercial supporting facilities, driving the steady improvement of consumption capacity in local and surrounding areas.

segments.src: - **晋江**作为闽南地区民营经济的重要发源地，孕育了多个知名消费品牌，本地产业与消费市场形成了紧密的联动效应，品牌经济对区域消费的拉动作用较为突出。
segments.tr: - **Jinjiang**, as an important birthplace of the private economy in the Minnan region, has nurtured multiple well-known consumer brands. The local industry and consumer market have formed a close linkage effect, and the driving role of the brand economy on regional consumption is relatively prominent.

segments.src: - **常熟**则凭借纺织服装产业集群优势，叠加长三角一体化发展带来的区域协同效应，商贸流通体系不断完善，消费市场保持了持续增长态势。
segments.tr: - **Changshu**, relying on the cluster advantage of the textile and garment industry, coupled with the regional synergy effect brought by the integration development of the Yangtze River Delta, has continuously improved its trade and logistics system, and the consumer market has maintained a sustained growth trend.

segments.src: ## 县域经济为何成为观察内需的新窗口
segments.tr: ## Why the county-level economy has become a new window for observing domestic demand

segments.src: 多位经济研究人士表示，县域经济体量虽然单体规模不及一线城市，但其数量众多、覆盖面广，且往往与制造业基础紧密结合，形成了“产业强、就业稳、消费旺”的正向循环。这种模式使得县域消费市场对宏观经济的边际贡献不容忽视。
segments.tr: Multiple economic researchers stated that although the single scale of the county-level economy is not as large as that of tier-1 cities, it is numerous in number, wide in coverage, and often closely combined with the manufacturing foundation, forming a positive cycle of "strong industry, stable employment, and prosperous consumption." This model makes the marginal contribution of the county-level consumer market to the macroeconomic impossible to ignore.

segments.src: 此外，随着近年来交通基础设施不断完善、公共服务水平持续提升，越来越多的县域开始具备承接产业转移和人口集聚的能力，进一步为本地消费市场注入活力。分析普遍认为，未来一段时间内，具备产业特色鲜明、区位条件优越、营商环境良好等特点的县域,仍有望在消费增长方面保持领先态势。
segments.tr: In addition, with the continuous improvement of transportation infrastructure and the continuous enhancement of public service levels in recent years, more and more counties have begun to possess the ability to undertake industrial transfer and population agglomeration, further injecting vitality into the local consumer market. Analysts generally believe that in a future period of time, counties with characteristics such as distinct industrial characteristics, superior geographical conditions, and a good business environment are still expected to maintain a leading position in consumption growth.

segments.src: 从义乌到昆山、晋江、常熟，这些跻身千亿元俱乐部的县域,共同勾勒出了当前中国县域消费的活跃图景。它们的发展路径虽各有不同,但都体现出产业基础与消费市场协同发展的共性规律。随着县域经济持续释放潜力,这一层级的市场表现或将继续成为观察中国内需韧性的重要参考维度。
segments.tr: From Yiwu to Kunshan, Jinjiang, and Changshu, these counties that have entered the 100-billion-yuan club jointly outline the active picture of current China's county-level consumption. Although their development paths are different, they all reflect the common regularity of the coordinated development of industrial foundation and consumer market. As the county-level economy continues to release potential, the market performance of this tier may continue to serve as an important reference dimension for observing China's domestic demand resilience.
